title: Minecraft's Most Advanced TnT Weapon is Here
description:
It's finally here, the orbital strike cannon Mk.6. After witnessing creators from lifesteal anarchy such as @OnlyASquid, @wemmbumc and @minutetechmc attempt world domination with my older designs. I was inspired to make a brand new design boasting an array of features to make minecraft's ultimate weapons platform. We make use of advanced technologies like wireless redstone, redstone computing and some of the most insane TnT explosion interactions that will blow your mind. In this video we go fully into detail on the cannon and how to implement its design on a server environment, with tips and tricks for how to build the orbital strike cannon and maintain its dominance over your world. This is the orbital strike cannon 6.0, minecraft's ultimate tnt super weapon.

@JKM115's Latest Wavetech update video, be sure to catch up on the last one for info about the perimeter cannons:
https://youtu.be/KCu0ZPjddFo?si=CIdmCHqHJOoULCHL
